text:
Le prompt je l'ai piqué à l'origine sur Linkedin (hier soir :sweat_smile:) et remodelé rapidement pour que ça fit + dans notre cas. Je vous encourage vraiment à le reprendre / modif et tester sur plusieurs tools IA (je trouve Claude super pour ça)

[𝗕𝗘𝗚𝗜𝗡 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗧]
I lead marketing for [brand] in the [industry] space. We're focused on improving how [audience] discover and trust us across AI-generated search, especially ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews.
Please analyze our current AI visibility and provide specific recommendations:
𝗔𝗜 𝗩𝗜𝗦𝗜𝗕𝗜𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗬 & 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 𝗔𝗡𝗔𝗟𝗬𝗦𝗜𝗦
→ Test 15-20 relevant prompts across different AI models - what percentage mention our brand? → Which competitors appear most frequently and in what context (leader, alternative, etc.)? → What specific URLs are being cited? Are they our best pages or outdated content? → *Gap Analysis*: What high-value prompts should mention us but don't? → *Position Analysis*: When we do appear, are we presented as a leader, alternative, or afterthought?
𝗕𝗢𝗧𝗧𝗢𝗠-𝗙𝗨𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗟 𝗖𝗢𝗡𝗩𝗘𝗥𝗦𝗜𝗢𝗡 𝗜𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗡𝗧 𝗖𝗢𝗩𝗘𝗥𝗔𝗚𝗘
→ *High-Intent Prompts*: Test specific buying-intent phrases like "best [category] for [use case]", "[competitor] vs [category]", "[category] pricing comparison" → *Comparison Coverage*: Do we appear in head-to-head comparisons with top 3 competitors? → *Use Case Alignment*: Are we mentioned for our strongest use cases and differentiators? → *Buying Journey*: Test prompts from awareness ("what is [category]") to decision ("should I choose [competitor] or [category]")
𝗖𝗢𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗡𝗧 & 𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗜𝗧𝗬 𝗖𝗢𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗘𝗡𝗖𝗘 𝗔𝗨𝗗𝗜𝗧
→ *Entity Description*: How are we described across different AI responses? Is it consistent with our positioning? → *Messaging Gaps*: What key differentiators or features are consistently missing from AI descriptions? → *Factual Accuracy*: Are there outdated facts, pricing, or feature descriptions that need correction? → *Competitive Framing*: How are we positioned relative to competitors - accurately or unfavorably?
𝗦𝗣𝗘𝗖𝗜𝗙𝗜𝗖 𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 𝗣𝗟𝗔𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦
→ *Content Optimization*: Which existing pages need SEO/content updates to improve AI citation likelihood? → *Content Gaps*: What new pages/content should we create (comparison pages, use case studies, FAQ sections)? → *Schema & Structured Data*: Specific schema markup recommendations for better AI understanding → *Third-Party Influence*: Priority list of publications, directories, or review sites to target for coverage → *Messaging Alignment*: Specific language/phrases to incorporate across all content to match AI output patterns
𝗠𝗘𝗔𝗦𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧 & 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗚𝗬
→ *Baseline Metrics*: Create a scoring system (0-100) for current AI visibility across key prompt categories → *Monitoring Tools*: Specific tools for tracking AI mentions (BrightEdge AI, Authoritas, custom solutions) → *Weekly Workflow*: Step-by-step process for team to test prompts and track changes → *Progress Tracking*: KPIs to measure improvement (mention frequency, position quality, citation accuracy) → *Competitive Benchmarking*: Monthly comparison against top 3 competitors across same prompt set
𝗣𝗥𝗜𝗢𝗥𝗜𝗧𝗜𝗭𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡 𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗫
Please rank all recommendations by: → *Impact*: High/Medium/Low effect on AI visibility → *Effort*: Resources and time required → *Timeline*: Quick wins (1-2 weeks) vs long-term initiatives (3+ months) → *Dependencies*: What needs to happen first
Provide specific, implementable recommendations our team can execute immediately.
[𝗘𝗡𝗗 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗧]

text:
Bien vu <@U0183AS3MB6>, j'avais spotté que ça marchait pas mais j'ai oublié d'updater le prompt :disappointed:. Voilà ce que Claude m'avait répondu par rapport à ça :
> *What AI tools like me and ChatGPT CAN'T do:*
> • We can't systematically test prompts across multiple AI models and compare results
> • We can't access other AI systems to see what they're saying about your brand
> • We can't run automated brand monitoring across different AI platforms
> • We can't provide real-time competitive analysis of AI mentions
> *What we CAN do:*
> • Test individual prompts within our own system (so I can test how Claude responds to prompts about your brand)
> • Use web search to find recent information about your brand and competitors
> • Analyze publicly available content that AI models might reference
> • Provide strategic recommendations based on general AI behavior patterns
Du coup il avait testé 20 queries sur son système à lui. Ce qui en soit est déjà cool :+1:
